title: 分区和I/O对齐为何影响4K物理扇区设备？

title: 误删后为何应尽快停止对原文件系统的写入？

def invoke(client,function,*args):
    offset=len(client.records);result=function(client,*args)
    return result,client.records[offset:]

def native_json(value):return json.dumps(value,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'),ensure_ascii=False,allow_nan=False)

def bound_mon(value,records,prefix,**kw):
    native=[json.loads(r[3])for r in records if r[0]=='mon'and r[2]==0 and r[1].get('prefix')==prefix and all(r[1].get(k)==v for k,v in kw.items())]
    assert native and any(native_json(value)==native_json(x)for x in native),'reported JSON was not returned by this operation on real Ceph'

def same_bool(actual,expected,label):
    assert type(actual)is bool and actual is expected,label

    pid=c.pool(size=3)
    def check(capacity,down,recovery):
        r,receipts=invoke(c.client,task.report);assert set(r)=={'fsid','capacity_warning','unavailable_osds','recovery_required','pg_states','raw'}
        assert r['fsid']==c.fsid and r['unavailable_osds']==down

import json,os,pathlib,socket,subprocess,tempfile,time,uuid
import rados
assert os.geteuid()==1000
TOOL=pathlib.Path('/tmp/opsforge-session07-20261029/native')
ENV={**os.environ,'LD_LIBRARY_PATH':str(TOOL/'usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/ceph')+':'+str(TOOL/'usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu')+':'+str(TOOL/'lib/x86_64-linux-gnu'),'PYTHONPATH':str(TOOL/'usr/lib/python3/dist-packages')}
def command(name,*args,timeout=20):
 result=subprocess.run([str(TOOL/'usr/bin'/name),*map(str,args)],env=ENV,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=timeout)
 if result.returncode:raise RuntimeError(name+' private command failed: '+result.stdout[-1000:]+result.stderr[-3000:])
 return result.stdout
def port():
 with socket.socket() as endpoint:endpoint.bind(('127.0.0.1',0));return endpoint.getsockname()[1]
class PrivateCeph:
 def __enter__(self):
  self.temp=tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='of-session07-ceph-');self.root=pathlib.Path(self.temp.name);self.processes=[];self.logs=[];self.client=None
  try:
   self.fsid=str(uuid.uuid4());self.monport=port();self.config=self.root/'ceph.conf';self.monmap=self.root/'monmap';self.mondata=self.root/'mon.a';self.mondata.mkdir()
   (self.root/'run').mkdir();(self.root/'crash').mkdir()
   self.config.write_text('''[global]
plugin dir = {tool}/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/ceph
mon cluster log file = {root}/cluster.log
mon cluster log to file = false
fsid = {fsid}

auth service required = none

pid file = {root}/$name.pid

mon data avail crit = 0
mon data avail warn = 0
mon allow pool delete = true
mon allow pool size one = true

[mon.a]

mon addr = 127.0.0.1:{port}

osd objectstore = memstore

osd op num threads per shard = 1

osd op num threads per shard hdd = 1

osd op num threads per shard ssd = 1
osd recovery max active = 1
osd max backfills = 1

erasure code dir = {tool}/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/ceph/erasure-code
'''.format(fsid=self.fsid,port=self.monport,root=self.root,tool=TOOL))
   command('monmaptool','--create','--fsid',self.fsid,'--add','a','127.0.0.1:'+str(self.monport),self.monmap)
   command('ceph-authtool','--create-keyring',self.root/'mon.keyring','--gen-key','-n','mon.')
   command('ceph-mon','--mkfs','-i','a','-c',self.config,'--monmap',self.monmap,'--mon-data',self.mondata,'--keyring',self.root/'mon.keyring')
   monitor=self.start('ceph-mon','-f','-i','a','-c',self.config,'--mon-data',self.mondata,'--setuser','1000','--setgroup','1000')
   deadline=time.monotonic()+20;last=None
   while time.monotonic()<deadline:
    if monitor.poll() is not None:raise RuntimeError('private MON exited before readiness: '+self.log_tail())
    try:
     status=json.loads(command('ceph','--admin-daemon',self.root/'mon.a.asok','mon_status',timeout=3))
     if status.get('state') not in ('leader','peon'):time.sleep(.2);continue
     assert status['monmap']['fsid']==self.fsid;break
    except Exception as error:
     last=error
     time.sleep(.2)
   else:raise RuntimeError('private MON readiness failed: '+str(last)+' '+self.log_tail())
   print('NATIVE_PRIVATE_CEPH_MON_READY '+json.dumps({'fsid':self.fsid,'uid':os.geteuid(),'quorum':status.get('quorum'),'network':'none-loopback-only'}),flush=True)
   self.client=rados.Rados(conffile=str(self.config),name='client.admin');self.client.connect(timeout=3)
   return self
  except BaseException:self.__exit__(None,None,None);raise
 def start(self,name,*args):
  log=(self.root/(name+'-'+str(len(self.processes))+'.log')).open('wb');self.logs.append(log)
  process=subprocess.Popen([str(TOOL/'usr/bin'/name),*map(str,args)],env=ENV,stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,stdout=log,stderr=log);self.processes.append(process)
  return process
 def mon(self,prefix,**kwargs):
  rc,out,err=self.client.mon_command(json.dumps({'prefix':prefix,'format':'json',**kwargs}),b'')
  if rc:raise RuntimeError('private mon command '+prefix+' failed: '+str(rc)+' '+str(err))
  try:return json.loads(out)
  except json.JSONDecodeError:return out.decode().strip()
 def add_osd(self):
  osduuid=str(uuid.uuid4());created=self.mon('osd create',uuid=osduuid);osdid=int(created['osdid'] if isinstance(created,dict) else created);data=self.root/('osd.'+str(osdid));data.mkdir()
  command('ceph-osd','--mkfs','--mkkey','-i',osdid,'-c',self.config,'--osd-uuid',osduuid,'--osd-data',data,'--osd-objectstore','memstore','--setuser','1000','--setgroup','1000')
  process=self.start('ceph-osd','-f','-i',osdid,'-c',self.config,'--osd-data',data,'--osd-objectstore','memstore','--setuser','1000','--setgroup','1000')
  deadline=time.monotonic()+20
  while time.monotonic()<deadline:
   if process.poll() is not None:raise RuntimeError('private OSD exited: '+self.log_tail())
   status=self.mon('osd dump');row=next((row for row in status['osds'] if row['osd']==osdid),None)
   if row and row['up']==1 and row['in']==1:break
   time.sleep(.2)
  else:raise RuntimeError('private OSD readiness timeout: '+self.log_tail())
  print('NATIVE_PRIVATE_CEPH_MEMSTORE_OSD_READY '+str(osdid),flush=True);return osdid
 def log_tail(self):
  return '\n'.join(path.read_text(errors='replace')[-2500:] for path in self.root.glob('*.log'))
 def __exit__(self,*args):
  if self.client:
   try:self.client.shutdown()
   except Exception:pass
  for process in reversed(self.processes):
   if process.poll() is None:process.terminate()
   try:process.wait(timeout=8)
   except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:process.kill();process.wait(timeout=3)
  for log in self.logs:log.close()
  self.temp.cleanup()


def native_trace(record):
 path=pathlib.Path.cwd()/'checks/native-commands.jsonl'
 if path.parent.is_dir():
  with path.open('a',encoding='utf8')as stream:stream.write(json.dumps({'at_ns':time.time_ns(),'uid':os.getuid(),**record})+'\n')

import copy

class TracingClient:
 def __init__(self,client):self.real=client;self._records=[]
 @property
 def records(self):return copy.deepcopy(self._records)
 def __getattr__(self,name):return getattr(self.real,name)
 def mon_command(self,command,*args,**kwargs):
  result=self.real.mon_command(command,*args,**kwargs)
  self._records.append(('mon',json.loads(command),result[0],result[1],str(result[2])))
  native_trace({'kind':'real_rados_mon_command','request':json.loads(command),'rc':result[0],'stdout':result[1].decode('utf8','replace'),'stderr':str(result[2])})
  return result
 def pg_command(self,pgid,command,*args,**kwargs):
  result=self.real.pg_command(pgid,command,*args,**kwargs)
  self._records.append(('pg',{'pgid':pgid,**json.loads(command)},result[0],result[1],str(result[2])))
  native_trace({'kind':'real_rados_pg_command','request':{'pgid':pgid,**json.loads(command)},'rc':result[0],'stdout':result[1].decode('utf8','replace'),'stderr':str(result[2])})
  return result

_original_command=command
def command(name,*args,timeout=20):
 argv=[str(TOOL/'usr/bin'/name),*map(str,args)]
 result=subprocess.run(argv,env=ENV,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=timeout)
 native_trace({'kind':'real_subprocess','argv':argv,'rc':result.returncode,'stdout':result.stdout,'stderr':result.stderr})
 if result.returncode:raise RuntimeError(name+' private command failed: '+result.stdout[-1000:]+result.stderr[-3000:])
 return result.stdout

class TopologyCeph(PrivateCeph):
 def start(self,name,*args):
  process=super().start(name,*args)
  print('NATIVE_OWNED_PROCESS_START '+json.dumps({'pid':process.pid,'argv':[str(TOOL/'usr/bin'/name),*map(str,args)]}),flush=True)
  return process
 def __enter__(self):
  self.parent_identity=(os.geteuid(),os.environ.get('HOME'),os.environ.get('PATH'))
  super().__enter__()
  self.client=TracingClient(self.client)
  try:
   (self.root/'mgr.a').mkdir()
   self.config.write_text(self.config.read_text()+'\n[mgr]\nmgr data = '+str(self.root/'mgr.a')+'\nmgr module path = '+str(TOOL/'usr/share/ceph/mgr')+'\nmgr initial modules = \nmgr tick period = 1\n[osd]\nosd pg stat report interval max = 1\n')
   self.manager=self.start('ceph-mgr','-f','-i','a','-c',self.config,'--setuser','1000','--setgroup','1000')
   self.wait(lambda:self.mon('mgr dump').get('available'),'manager available')
   self.osds={}
   for _ in range(3):
    ident=self.add_osd();self.osds[ident]=self.processes[-1]
   self.mon('osd set',key='noout')
   print('NATIVE_TOPOLOGY_READY '+json.dumps({'fsid':self.fsid,'uid':os.getuid(),'pids':[p.pid for p in self.processes],'monport':self.monport}),flush=True)
   return self
  except BaseException:self.__exit__(None,None,None);raise
 def wait(self,predicate,label,seconds=25):
  until=time.monotonic()+seconds;last=None
  while time.monotonic()<until:
   if any(p.poll()is not None for p in self.processes if p is self.manager):raise RuntimeError('NATIVE_ENVIRONMENT_ERROR: mgr exited '+self.log_tail())
   try:
    result=predicate()
    if result:return result
   except Exception as error:last=error
   time.sleep(.25)
  raise RuntimeError('NATIVE_ENVIRONMENT_ERROR: '+label+' deadline '+str(last)+' '+self.log_tail())
 def pool(self,name='owned',size=2,pg=4):
  self.mon('osd pool create',pool=name,pg_num=pg,pgp_num=pg,pool_type='replicated')
  self.mon('osd pool set',pool=name,var='size',val=str(size))
  self.mon('osd pool set',pool=name,var='min_size',val='1')
  self.mon('osd pool application enable',pool=name,app='opsforge')
  pid=next(p['pool']for p in self.mon('osd dump')['pools']if p['pool_name']==name)
  self.wait_clean(pid,pg)
  with self.client.open_ioctx(name)as io:
   for index in range(16):io.write_full('obj-'+str(index),('known-payload-'+str(index)).encode())
  self.wait_clean(pid,pg)
  return pid
 def pg_rows(self,pid=None):
  rows=self.mon('pg dump',dumpcontents=['pgs'])['pg_stats']
  return [x for x in rows if pid is None or x['pgid'].startswith(str(pid)+'.')]
 def wait_clean(self,pid,pg=4):
  return self.wait(lambda:(lambda rows:rows if len(rows)==pg and all(set(x['state'].split('+'))=={'active','clean'}for x in rows)else None)(self.pg_rows(pid)),'all owned PG active+clean')
 def stop_osd(self,ident):
  process=self.osds[ident]
  if process.poll()is None:process.terminate();process.wait(timeout=8)
  self.mon('osd down',ids=[str(ident)])
  self.wait(lambda:next(x for x in self.mon('osd dump')['osds']if x['osd']==ident)['up']==0,'owned OSD down')
 def restart_osd(self,ident):
  process=self.start('ceph-osd','-f','-i',ident,'-c',self.config,'--osd-data',self.root/('osd.'+str(ident)),'--osd-objectstore','memstore','--setuser','1000','--setgroup','1000');self.osds[ident]=process
  self.mon('osd in',ids=[str(ident)])
  self.wait(lambda:next(x for x in self.mon('osd dump')['osds']if x['osd']==ident)['up']==1,'owned OSD restarted')
 def verify_payloads(self,name='owned'):
  with self.client.open_ioctx(name)as io:
   for index in range(16):assert io.read('obj-'+str(index))==('known-payload-'+str(index)).encode(),'native payload not recovered'
 def __exit__(self,*args):
  pids=[p.pid for p in self.processes];root=self.root
  super().__exit__(*args)
  assert all(p.poll()is not None for p in self.processes),'owned daemon leaked'
  assert not root.exists(),'owned directory leaked'
  assert self.parent_identity==(os.geteuid(),os.environ.get('HOME'),os.environ.get('PATH')),'default process identity/environment changed'
  print('NATIVE_TOPOLOGY_CLEANED '+json.dumps({'pids':pids,'returncodes':[p.returncode for p in self.processes],'directory_removed':True,'identity_preserved':True}),flush=True)

## 操作任务
交付diagnose(client,threshold)，threshold为0–86400的整数秒（拒绝bool）。分别查询真实pg dump_stuck的inactive/unclean/undersized分类，按pgid合并，返回{threshold,stuck:[{pgid,state,categories,osd_candidates}],osd_map:原生osd dump,capacity:原生df,peering:{pgid:原生PG query}}；每个stuck PG须用client.pg_command(pgid,JSON{prefix=query,pgid},空bytes,timeout=3)读取当前peering状态/历史与恢复状态，关联OSD map和实际容量，不把stuck本身当根因。pgid升序，categories按inactive/unclean/undersized顺序，osd_candidates是原生up/acting并集升序。stuck是状态持续超过阈值的分类，不是PG独立根因；不得把全部不clean PG无视阈值塞进stuck，也不得自动repair或lost。教师启动真实副本PG、让OSD停止但保持in，在短/长阈值下核对原生命令差异，再恢复OSD并核验全部PG收敛和数据内容。单机原生故障演练不证明生产恢复时限。

保留原题知识：stuck是状态持续超过阈值的分类，不是独立根因。检查是inactive、unclean还是undersized，并关联OSD、容量和peering日志，验收具体状态收敛。

 def mon_command(self,command,*args,**kwargs):
